verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own security page covers only part of the digital-protection side of this story. It documents 2FA with authenticator-app one-time passcodes, and lets customers request that mail not be opened or scanned but shipped instead. Nothing in the pack describes how mail is physically secured at the facility, how staff are screened, or whether scans are encrypted. missing for 10: facility/physical access controls, staff background screening, encryption of scans in transit and at rest, independent audits or certifications.
